setup.t: Run now isn’t set up for {{slots}}
setup.b: Planning, development and QA are separate routines, each with its own trigger token. The console needs two values per routine, set once from a computer; the runs that are set up keep working.
setup.s1: In Claude Code, open {{name}}’s routines for {{slots}} and add an API trigger to each. Claude shows the token once; the trigger URL holds the routine id (trig_…).
setup.s2: Save both as the console’s secrets: in your team-console checkout, in the terminal where you ran npx wrangler login (as for OWNER_EMAIL in the owner checklist). Each command asks for the value at a hidden prompt, so it never lands in your shell history:
setup.warn: Paste the token only at that hidden prompt — never into the chat, an issue or an agent. If it leaked, regenerate it in Claude Code: the old one stops working.
setup.s3: Come back here and refresh the status: Run turns on by itself.
